Subject: Data retention exception - FinSecure (post-call recap)

Thanks again for the call this morning - great to meet the FinSecure team. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

What we heard:
- FinSecure needs assurance that user PII and full request/response payloads will not be retained by Redwood for this workload.
- You are evaluating a short-term (pilot) exception while you validate model outputs; long-term needs TBD.
- Legal will want written DPA language and a signed exception for any deviations from standard retention.

Redwood options we discussed:
1) 0-retention for payloads (request/response) - we can configure the pipeline so content is not stored after inference.
2) Shortened logs (7 days) - keep minimal, pseudonymized telemetry for operational health; remove any PII fields.
3) Custom retention schedule - we can commit to a tailored retention window for metadata only; payloads zero-retention.

Attachments: SOC2-Summary.pdf (high-level controls) - attached for Legal/InfoSec.

Next steps (proposed):
- Olivia/Tim: confirm whether FinSecure requires a signed short-term exception for the pilot and whether Legal needs 0-retention in writing or an updated DPA redline.
- Camila/Marissa/Neha: we will prepare DPA redlines and an exception request form for review (target EOD tomorrow).
- Rafael: can you standby for Legal escalation if FinSecure pushes for contract-level changes?

If helpful I can also propose exact config names for the pilot (zero_payload_retention + telemetry_minimal).

Best,
Camila Reyes

Thanks Camila - helpful summary. A few clarifying Qs from our side: 

1) When you say 0-retention for payloads, can Redwood provide a written guarantee that no request/response payloads (including any derived embeddings) will be written to any persistent storage accessible after inference? We need this in writing for our audit.
2) What telemetry would be retained in the "minimal" option? We need the specific fields (IP, user id, request id, timestamps) spelled out; PII must be excluded.
3) Do you have a sample DPA redline we can start from? Our Legal will review and may propose changes.

For the pilot we prefer a 0-retention commitment for payloads; if that's not possible we can consider the 7-day shortened logs approach but only if logs are scrubbed of PII and scoped to operational telemetry.

Please include your Legal/Contract POC. Also copying Tim (Engineering) and our Legal team.

Olivia - thanks, great questions. Answers and concrete proposal below. Also attached a first-pass DPA with redlines for your Legal to review (DPA-redlines.docx).

1) 0-retention guarantee for payloads:
- We can operate the pilot in a 0-retention mode for request and response payloads. Implementation detail: request/response payloads will be processed in-memory and not written to long-term object storage or database. Short-lived buffers may exist in memory during processing but are not persisted. Redwood can provide a written exception letter outlining this behavior and the configuration name (zero_payload_retention_v1).

2) Telemetry retained under "minimal" option:
- request_id (UUID)
- timestamp (ISO8601)
- model_version
- inference_duration_ms
- host_region

We will explicitly drop or hash any user-identifying fields (user_id, email, IP) before storage. No full-text request or response data will be stored.

3) DPA redline: attached. It highlights the 0-retention clause and a short-term exception path. If Legal needs stronger contractual language we will escalate.

Proposed ask from FinSecure to move forward:
- Confirm you want zero_payload_retention_v1 for the pilot and Legal will accept an exception letter + redlined DPA for now.
- Provide Legal POC and any required internal sign-off path.

I'll prepare the Retention-Exception-Request.pdf (fillable) and circulate internally for Rafael to sign if needed.

Best,
Camila

Olivia/Tim - following up with a concrete path forward so we can get the pilot started this week: 

Agreement proposal (pilot):
- Scope: pilot for 3 teams, dev and prod test cluster.
- Data handling: zero_payload_retention_v1 - no request/response payloads persisted.
- Minimal telemetry persisted (request_id, timestamp, model_version, inference_duration_ms, host_region). All user-identifying fields will be hashed/dropped prior to storage.
- Retention window: telemetry retained for 7 days, then purged automatically. No payload retention at any time.
- Contract: Redwood will provide an Exception Letter that references the zero_payload_retention_v1 config and the attached DPA redlines. FinSecure Legal to review and return sign-off or counter-redlines.

Docs and links:
- Retention-Exception-Request.pdf (attached) - please fill and return.
- DPA redlines: uploaded and attached.
- DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/FinSecure-DPA-exception (we will send once Legal confirms).

If FinSecure agrees to the above for the pilot, please reply-all with Legal POC and we will route the exception through Rafael for signature. If Legal needs a different retention window or additional contractual guarantees, we will review and escalate.

Thanks - looking forward to getting this moving.
